main_text.l: ARTICULUS III.
VT evadat Toletus lib. 1. phys. cap. 9. qu. 17.
Negandum, inquit, est prorsus cum Aristotele,
formas fieri aut produci, sed composita fiunt, non ex
nihilo, sed ex materia, forma verò consequenter fiunt
& comproducuntur; unde non est ipsarum creatio,
quia creatio est actio, qua aliquid primò fit, formæ
verò non primò fiunt, hæc autem est vis concessa agen-
tibus naturalibus, ut compositum producerent, ac si-
mul mediante formas attingerent, quod non est creare,
nec aliam philosophiam habemus ab Aristotele, & est
optima & notanda. Fateor, hanc esse philosophiam

page.notes: Running head and page number read clearly. The catchword "fendi" and the signature "I 5" are at the foot. Doubtful: the decorative initial "VT" is read as V plus T, and "Quid ergo ?" keeps the space before the question mark as printed. The line "Aristotelis,quæ" has a missing space in print, which is kept as "Aristotelis, quæ" with the space added for legibility; the printed spacing is not certain. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout, including "phys." for printed "phyf.".
